title: Ex 5: More Variables and Printing
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 5 · More Variables and Printing

用 f-string 或 `.format` 把变量嵌进字符串。

starterFiles.ex05.py:
my_name = "Zed A. Shaw"
my_age = 35
my_height = 74  # inches
my_weight = 180  # lbs

print(f"Let's talk about {my_name}.")
print(f"He's {my_height} inches tall.")
print(f"He's {my_weight} pounds heavy.")
